_comment: Lambda execution role for the orchestrator. Data, not console clicks, for the same reasons the guardrail and alarms are (design.md 10.1): reviewable in a pull request, diffable over time, reproducible in another account. Under IaC this becomes a CDK Role construct. Apply with scripts/apply_iam.py.
_naming: The -dev suffix follows config/alarms.json: generated resources coexist with manually created ones during the migration to IaC (design.md 11, point 2).
description: Execution role for the Smart Grocery & Meal Budget Assistant orchestrator Lambda.
_managed_note: AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole covers CreateLogGroup/CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents only. Powertools Metrics needs no cloudwatch:PutMetricData -- it emits Embedded Metric Format to stdout and CloudWatch extracts the metrics from the log records. Granting PutMetricData would be permission for a call the code never makes.

Statement._comment: Cross-region inference profiles need BOTH the profile ARN in this region AND the underlying foundation model in every region the profile can route to. config/models.json uses apac.* and au.* profiles, which span multiple APAC regions; granting only the profile ARN yields an opaque AccessDeniedException naming a region nobody configured. The foundation-model ARNs are region-wildcarded for that reason and account-less by design -- foundation models are AWS-owned, not account resources.

Guardrail is applied on every model call when REQUIRE_GUARDRAIL=1. Version 1 is the published version; DRAFT is deliberately not granted so a console edit to DRAFT cannot silently change runtime behaviour.

Read-only on products. The orchestrator never writes prices -- ingestion does, under a separate role. GSI1 is a distinct resource ARN and must be listed explicitly; omitting it is a common cause of a working GetItem and a failing cheapest-price Query. Scan is required and easy to miss: DynamoPriceRepository.candidates_for_budget pages the base table because it needs cross-product, cross-store coverage filtered by category, so without it every MEAL PLAN turn fails AccessDenied while price checks keep working -- the read path exercised least by a smoke test. It stays read-only; Scan reads.

Idempotency needs conditional writes: PutItem with attribute_not_exists for the atomic claim, UpdateItem to record the terminal outcome, GetItem on retry. No Delete -- expiry is by TTL, which requires no permission.
Powertools Tracer. X-Ray segment writes are not resource-scopable -- the API takes no resource -- so * is the only expressible form.
